name: Pumpgrip Tonic
description: Settle the feet and send qi down the arms so the shot leaves the barrel with weight behind it.

name: Sure Choke
description: Pack the wad with qi so the pellets leave the muzzle as a tight driven mass.

name: Ruthless Doublebarrel
description: Fire a driven load at one foe so the pellets strike together as a single heavy blow.

name: Springing Pattern
description: Step in along the foe's weapon side so the muzzle ends hard against his body.

name: Shellbandage
description: Feel through the stock how the load drove and trim the next charge by it.

name: Cruel Bead
description: Compress the pellets with qi at the muzzle so the whole mass punches through light armour.

name: Harsh Slug
description: Fire a charge that opens late and wide so qi drives the pellets across a knot of foes.

name: Sure Sawnedge
description: Hold the breath at the doorway and listen with qi for foes breathing behind the wall.

name: Springing Shell
description: Slide along the jamb into the room so the barrel clears the frame before the body does.

name: Rude Wad
description: Fire from just inside the door so the spread covers the near half of the room.

name: Slugslap
description: Fire through the doorway to hold a room of foes behind their furniture.

name: Gagging Blast
description: Jab the muzzle into a foe's wrist as he lifts a weapon so his blow goes wide.

name: Dense Slugchamber
description: Wedge the shoulder against the door leaf and hold it while qi steadies the legs.

name: Bold Spreadshot
description: Release a qi-driven burst through the doorway so pellets cover the whole room.

name: Shellbuckle
description: Turn the barrel against an incoming blade so the strike glances off into the doorframe.

name: Patient Pellet
description: Hold qi at the breech and keep the charge ready without letting it spend itself.

name: Pumpglide
description: Walk with the piece cocked and the held charge steady so a shot is always ready.

name: Savage Breech
description: Release the held charge in a sudden snap shot the moment a foe steps clear.

name: Choketonic
description: Sense the weight of the hammer's fall and judge when the charge will let go.

name: Keen Doublebarrel
description: Hold the charge a heartbeat past the trigger then let qi punch the pellets through a guard.

name: Pumpswat
description: Spend the held charge in a rolling release that pins a foe for several breaths.

name: Bold Buckshot
description: Snap the piece from the carry to the shoulder and fire before the foe finishes his step.

name: Poise Choke
description: Count a fixed rhythm through ram and pour and prime so the recharge never falters.

name: Breechbandage
description: Read a foe's stride and lead the muzzle ahead of it so the pattern meets him.

name: Fleet Slug
description: Dodge one pace off the line and fire from the new footing in the same breath.

name: Chokehasp
description: Flick the barrel against a lifted spear to knock its point aside.

name: Wadbarrier
description: Duck low under a swing with the stock tucked tight so the piece stays safe.

name: Shard Pump
description: Fire and recharge by qi spark so a second shot follows the first with scarcely a pause.

name: Purpose Slugchamber
description: Drive qi through the arms so powder and wad and pellets seat in a fraction of the usual time.

name: Clay Pump
description: Pivot on the run to loose a shot at a pursuer then press on without losing pace.

name: Rigid Wad
description: Lift the barrel across the body to parry a cut and keep the muzzle clear of the blade.

name: Shardchoke
description: Raise the stock to take a blow upon the hardwood and keep the barrel from harm.

name: Spliceshell
description: Slide the muzzle along a foe's guard to bind and unbalance his weapon.

name: Clayshell
description: Turn a parried blow into a swift stock smash against the foe's ribs.

name: Cometchoke
description: Fire point blank from behind a guard while the foe's blade is held away.

name: Brass Shell
description: Run qi through the barrel so it takes a heavy blow without bending.

name: Stalwart Sawnedge
description: Fire in the instant of a parry so the blast throws the foe's weapon wide.

name: Recall Pellet
description: Dress the line by feel so each muzzle falls clear of the neighbouring shooter's shoulder.

name: Slinking Spreadshot
description: Advance at a steady pace with the piece ready and fire upon the count.

name: Weighty Pattern
description: Fire by alternate ranks so the line keeps a cloud of pellets upon the foe without pause.

name: Grit Buckshot
description: Fire across open ground so the pellets cut through a loose cluster of foes.

name: Wadcordial
description: Step to the rear and recharge by the drill count while the next rank takes the front.

name: Recallblast
description: Use the smoke of the volley as a veil to cross the next stretch of ground unseen.

name: Guarding Bead
description: Plant the feet and brace the stock to hold the line against a charge.

name: Hungry Shell
description: Time qi into each pellet cloud so the volley lands in one rolling thud upon the foe.

name: Cinder Blast
description: Walk forward through a rolling set of spreads that sweep a whole front of foes before the line.

name: Pumpgrip Cordial
description: Share a thin thread of qi along the line so every shooter fires in the same breath.

name: Rooted Sawnedge
description: Lean against a low wall with the barrel across the top to fire without exposing the head.

name: Wadglide
description: Hop across rubble from one rest to the next with the muzzle never swinging free.

name: Dire Wad
description: Fire over cover into a knot of foes so the spread falls among them.

name: Breechtonic
description: Peek round cover for a single breath and pull back to plan the next shot.

name: Dire Pellet
description: Time a qi-driven spread to leave cover at its edge so foes beyond are caught in the open.

name: Armored Breech
description: Rest the barrel on stone and let qi lock the arms so the aim holds against a charge.

name: Brawn Pump
description: Stalk with soft footfalls and the barrel low until the foe is within reach of the spread.

name: Gap Choke
description: Judge how far the pellets will sink over distance and raise the muzzle to match.

name: Static Bead
description: Swing the muzzle up and through a leaping foe and fire as the line crosses.

name: Keen Pumpgrip
description: Fire into cover to flush a foe into the open then hold him there.

name: Sprout Doublebarrel
description: Slow the breath until the heartbeat is the only motion and the aim holds still.

name: Hum Slug
description: Swing the sling strap against a foe's legs to catch and trip him at close quarters.

name: Slugflog
description: Read the foe's leap with qi and place a driven load where he will land.

name: Cinder Spreadshot
description: Fire a wide spread that herds a pack of foes together and cuts those who bolt.
